U01首幀：34793323-1f6a-4db7-ab21-5c2c9d5fd44b，M03正面走來、米白覆臀西外敞開／白圓領T／偏灰深藍直筒褲／黑素面低跟鞋／深棕肩包，一手已輕扶包帶，辦公街玻璃建築與上班人流。
U02首幀：3f2a384a-d5a9-4615-86b8-3e24125fc71b，M03側面向右跨步、白短袖尖領襯衫／黑高腰及小腿A字裙／鈷藍肩包／素面黑低跟鞋（已修掉蝴蝶結），街口行穿線及後景通勤者。
兩鏡人物身份face：6236309c-2343-41e6-985c-994239ff744a；正常比例full：ac9ede4e-1715-4518-95b4-bda341a62061。兩張只鎖M03身份／比例，不複製參照衣服或站姿。各片只以自身核准圖作First frame兼服裝場景基準，不設Last frame，不混另一套。不要新生靜態圖、不改舊媒體、不重試、不合片。
U01: A continuous ten-second real-time metropolitan commute shot. She is already moving toward the camera at a purposeful brisk weekday pace. Aim for roughly18-20 grounded alternating footfalls over ten seconds, not long gliding slow-motion steps. Use ordinary walking tracks, firm heel-to-toe landings, relaxed shoulders and forward intention; no running or runway leg crossing. Track backward directly in front of her at matching walking speed, level chest-height50mm view, maintaining full head-to-shoe framing and readable open blazer/white tee/trousers. Her strap-side hand keeps the light hold visible in the starting image; the free arm counter-swings naturally. Keep her face frontal and focused ahead with an approachable composed expression, no head turn or posing. Commuters behind her walk naturally through their own lanes at different depths, remaining behind and clear of her face/clothes/feet. Let real street perspective and daylight shift coherently as the camera travels. Preserve exact M03 identity, normal proportions, wardrobe, dark-brown bag and plain black shoes.
U02: A continuous ten-second real-time side-tracking metropolitan commute shot. Start at the exact approved side-profile crossing image. She walks purposefully toward image-right at a brisk ordinary weekday pace, roughly18-20 grounded alternating footfalls over ten seconds. Track parallel alongside her at matching speed, maintaining the approved near-side-profile angle and full head-to-shoe framing with a level chest-height50mm view. Keep her head facing the walking direction throughout, never turn toward the camera. Her black calf-length A-line skirt moves naturally with real leg advancement; no slit or extra accessory. Keep the approved white pointed collar, short sleeves and tucked waist, cobalt-blue shoulder bag and plain black low heels with no bows. Background commuters continue plausible separate paths behind her; crossing stripes, office corner and trees retain rigid perspective with coherent lateral translation.
Both: active everyday city life with decisive, relaxed posture and polished clothing visibility. No slow motion, speed ramp, freeze, pose stop, orbit, zoom, cut, dissolve, outfit morph, extra main model, text or logos. Architecture stays rigid; background people must not merge, multiply, vanish suddenly or walk in front of the main clothes. Natural light and contact shadows unify people and environment. 音訊可關則關，若此模式仍帶AAC就如實回報不重生。完成列出真正使用First frame/face/full IDs、影片ID、實際時長/解析度/音軌；兩段分開保留，我先檢查步伐及鏡語再本機剪輯。
